messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — time for our quarterly access review. Need to run a least-privilege audit + admin entitlement cleanup across production clusters and KMS keys. Can we sketch a plan here? cc @Jess Ortega for People Ops timing

Samir Patel: +1. Proposed flow: export current entitlements, owners -> sheet, 2-week remediation window, then auto-suspend stale admin roles. I can run the export script. Doc: https://redwood.internal/sec/access-review

Jess Ortega: We need manager-level signoff notices. Do we have a single source of truth for role owners? Also looping in @Priya Singh for KMS owner mapping.

Devon Blake: I can pull audit logs (90d) and flag admin actions. Also want to identify service principals with admin scope but zero activity. Example query (ELK):
```
index=auth-logs action:admin* | stats count() by principal | where count == 0
```
That will give us candidates for review.

Maria Chen: Good. Important: do NOT remove any infra-critical role blindly. Plan a 'lock' (suspend) state first so we can rollback quickly.

Priya Singh: I'll export KMS key ACLs and cross-ref owners. Propose we rotate keys that have >5 owners and flag keys with non-human principals. Where should we put the export? Private sheet or encrypted S3?

Samir Patel: I'll run: `./tools/entitlement_audit.sh --export --format csv --since 90d` tonight and upload results to a secure location. Will add dry-run mode.

audit-bot: audit-bot: Scheduled entitlement scan starting at 02:00 UTC. Results will be posted to /secure/entitlements/1742001123.csv once finished.

Maria Chen: Proposed action items:
1) Samir: export owners + roles (done by EOD)
2) Devon: produce audit log activity + list of inactive admin principals
3) Priya: KMS cross-ref and key owner list
4) Jess: manager notification template + timeline
5) Security: 14-day suspend, 30-day remove for stale admin entitlements (with emergency restore process)
Are we aligned?

Jess Ortega: :thumbsup: I'll draft manager notice and include legal/compliance copy. Manager notice will include the remediation window and how to request exemptions.

Samir Patel: Question on policy: 14-day suspend -> 30-day removal sounds good but we need an approval path. Suggest: security@redwood.com approval within 48 hours to immediately restore if needed. Also add dry-run in the script and a `--notify` flag to DM owners.

Priya Singh: Works for KMS side. Any KMS key removal also needs HSM owner sign-off. I'll include an owners_count column in the export.

Devon Blake: If anyone has scheduled jobs tied to special service accounts, ping me now with the resource IDs. I can whitelist up to 3 service principals per team for this cycle.

Samir Patel: I'll open a PR to add `--dry-run` and `--notify` and a CSV schema. PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/entitlement-audit/pulls/42 (WIP)

Maria Chen: Perfect. Tentative timeline: export + audit -> managers notified by Fri -> 2-week remediation -> suspend/remove after window. Reconvene Tue for status. Thanks folks.

access-bot: access-bot: Cleanup run queued in dry-run mode. No changes will be made. Operators will be notified in #eng-security once the run completes.
